notes: This file never stores tokens. Create a token in your Forgejo/Gitea instance: Settings -> Applications -> Generate New Token.
Audion Hub Manager hands the token to the Git credential helper you already use (Git Credential Manager, wincred, libsecret, osxkeychain).

Scopes follow the route, not the object (verified on a live Forgejo 15): read:user for identity and the repository list, write:user to CREATE a repository because that route lives under /api/v1/user/*, and read/write:repository for git clone/push over HTTPS, which is judged separately from the API.
preferred_url_type selects how remote URLs are built: ssh uses your SSH key, https uses the stored token.
Set ssh_port when the instance exposes SSH on a non-standard port; the URL then becomes ssh://git@host:PORT/owner/repo.git.
